key_decisions: PRUNED IS FINAL and the unpruned 34 GB file is DELETED. Of the three candidate arguments only DOWNLOAD SIZE survived: speed died (the sign flips between canvases and both deltas sit inside noise) and resident memory died on 2026-08-05 (ComfyUI streams per layer). The one real quality difference is TEMPORAL - unpruned is slightly more expressive - and it was only ever observed at 56 frames, so it is NOT proven to stay small on long clips. Re-testing costs a 32 GB re-download.

very_high = 1088x1920, and the ladder SHIFTED rather than being overwritten: native 768x1344 moved to high so it stays selectable. Mirrors WAN, which already ships an above-native very_high called an extrapolated detail tier.
very_high is a FINAL-RENDER tier, not an iterate tier: 2x pixels costs 3.3x time (attention is quadratic in token count), so 1088x1920 is 25.6 min for a 2.33 s clip and roughly an hour at 124 frames.

H3 workflow routing derives mode from WHICH images are present (has_img1 / has_img2 through lazy MpiIfElse), not from user toggles - so illegal states are unreachable. LTX should adopt this shape too (MPI-455).
H3 ships 6 LoRA slots with model AND clip strength via MpiLoraModelClip - the established node, NOT core LoraLoader.
constraints: MEMORY IS A POOR PREDICTOR FOR H3 IN BOTH DIRECTIONS - falsified by file size (2026-08-05) and by canvas size (2026-08-06, 13.2/16 GB at 2.09 MP, LOWER than at 640x640, because ComfyUI keeps fewer weights resident to leave room for activations). Stop using it to predict anything here.

execution_cached LISTING A NODE IS NOT EVIDENCE IT WAS NEEDED. Leaf constant nodes cache per value, so booleans show cached whichever way they are flipped. To tell pruned from cached, vary an input nothing has ever sampled.
Composition is NOT seed-stable across a canvas change - a different canvas is a different latent shape, so the same seed is a different sample. A tier A/B can never be read as "same shot, sharper".

The word "audio" in a latent node TITLE is load-bearing: _latentRoleFromTitle in commandExecutor.js tags any title containing it as role audio. Naming H3 single AV latent Output_AV_Latent would stage it as the audio latent and silently break stage-2 resume. Keep Input_Video_Latent / Output_Video_Latent.
model_lora_keys_unet has 17 named model branches and H3 is NOT one, so a Diffusers-format H3 LoRA loads WITHOUT ERROR and does nothing. Only plain diffusion_model.* / lora_unet_* keys map.
H3 frame counts are n % 17 == 5 at 24 fps; trained range 124-362 frames. The bench writes to D:/WORK/Images/Outputs, NOT G:/ComfyUi/ComfyUI/output.
Bench is port 8188 (v0.30.2); the APP engine is 48188 (v0.29.2). Do not confuse them.
comfy.nested_tensor is 0.30.0+; MpiNodes must import it INSIDE the function or the whole pack fails to load on the 0.29.2 app engine.
The bench has no ffprobe on PATH. Bundled binary: G:/ComfyUi/python_embeded/Lib/site-packages/imageio_ffmpeg/binaries/ffmpeg-win-x86_64-v7.1.exe (-map 0:v:0 -f null - prints the true frame count).
